tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong rang gis len pa'i cho ga bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bya ba'i rgyud sogs rgyud sde 'og ma'i cho ga phal cher gyi skabs gso sbyong rang gis len par gsungs pa'i tshul ni 'di yin te/ sgrub pa po rnams snga bar langs la sgrub khang gi phyi rol du yan lag lnga khrus legs par bya/ nang du 'ongs nas rten la kha phyogs par langs te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs par bsam/ dngos su phyag bya zhing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku// mdzes shing blta bas chog mi shes// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs// 'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan// mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa// bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra// bde gsal mi rtog ngang tshul ldan// rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi mdzad pa bla ma yin// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyobs pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang*// shākya thub pa gau tam lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe// phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag bskyab pa'i phyir// smon lam khyad par can rnams btab gyur pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu'i 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor bas// phyogs bcu'i 'gro kun yongs su skyob mdzad pa'i// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon gyi smon lam byang chub rjes spyad pas// mtshan tsam thos pas sgrib pa kun sel ba// phrin las mnga' ba kun mkhyen 'jig rten mgon// sangs rgyas sum cu lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung zhing*// spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la// bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me pa// mgon po mchog gyur khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig ma lus rkang gnyis gtso// dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid// gser gyi mdog can lha yi lhar gyur pa// dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// bai ḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// skur gyur pa ni thams cad la// mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' zhing*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*// gang du byang chub la reg dang*// zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// zag med mya ngan 'das phyag 'tshal// bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*// 'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi// gnas de la yang phyag 'tshal lo// steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*// skur bcas sku ni med pa yi// mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i bstan pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i lam// don dam dmigs med spros pa kun las 'das// dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam kun mkhyen ngo bo nyid// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog

/zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ma'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dbyug sngon can// stobs po che dang lha yi bu gnyis te// rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// don yod zhags pa khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal// ral gcig ma dang lha mo khro gnyer can// 'phags pa lha lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron me rab tu gsal// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// stobs po che la drag shul che// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba po// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa// rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi// dgra bcom blo mchog dbang po kun dul ba// bstan pa'i srid du legs par brtan bzhugs nas// bstan pa 'dzin dang spel dang srung mdzad pa'i// dgra bcom gnas brtan bcu drug la phyag 'tshal// zab mo rten 'brel bcu gnyis legs bsgoms pas// rang 'byung rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni// brten pa med pa'i tshul gyis thugs chud pa'i// 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs srung pa'i// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa// nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag

/de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces pas phyag bya/ de nas rang gnas su 'khod de rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol bya zhing*/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dang pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// zhes brjod/ rol mo bzhag ste/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams// byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pas yan lag bdun pa byas la/

pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te don yid la dran bzhin pas/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing*/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de rnams kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lhag par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o// zhes pa lan gsum gyis sdom pa blangs la/ de'i bslab bya 'di rnams la bslab snyam pas/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*// gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya// 'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*// brdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o// skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i// chang ni yongs su spang bar bya// khri stan che mtho mi bya zhing*// de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas// dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan// gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya// ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni// srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar// de ltar srog gcod la sogs spang*// bla med byang chub myur thob shog /sdug bsngal mang dkrugs sems can rnams// srid pa'i mtsho las 'don par shog /ces lan gsum brjod// de nas oṃ a mo gha shī la/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/

mahā shud+dha satwa/ pad+ma bi bhū ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs 'di lan nyer gcig bzlas pas tshul khrims sngar nyams pa rnams sos shing*/ phyin chad tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyi phung po 'phel zhing yongs su rdzogs pa sogs phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs so// de bzhin du don yod zhags pa'i snying po'ang bzla bar gsungs pas/ oṃ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥhā hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes bzla'o// de nas mthar smon lam gdab pa ni/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong la goms pa'i mthus// rmi lam na yang sdig sems mi 'byung zhing*// byang chub sems dang nam yang mi 'bral bar// tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa'ang phyag rabs sogs ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung rab rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi dbu nas 'byung ba bzhin bklag pas grub par bsdebs pa dge legs su gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
